convert_version_to_digits: convert a version string like '1.2.3a0' into a tuple of integers for comparison
compare_prerelease_versions: compare pre-release versions using digit_version to determine alpha beta or rc ordering
get_git_commit_hash: get the current git commit hash of the repository with optional digit truncation
run_subprocess_with_minimal_env: run a subprocess command with a minimal environment containing only SYSTEMROOT PATH and HOME
get_short_git_hash: get a truncated git commit hash by specifying the number of digits to keep
